task.title: Review All Settings attention items
task.shortdesc: Use Review mode to triage invalid, CIS manual-review, raw, unknown, deprecated, and imported items before routine editing.

prereq.p: Open a saved profile in All Settings.

context.p: Review mode is the default attention-first view. It gathers settings that may require a decision before export, comparison, or handoff.

step.cmd: Open All Settings and stay in Review mode.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Read the review summary and grouped action cards.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Open each invalid, CIS manual-review, raw, unknown, deprecated, or imported item that applies to the profile.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Resolve the item, document why it remains, or move to the linked detail view for a deliberate edit.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: Attention items are either resolved, intentionally retained, or ready for a focused detail edit.

postreq.p: Recovery: if Review looks empty but you expected issues, clear filters, refresh the profile, and confirm the selected schema channel.
